messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need to finalize Private deployment launch criteria for Q3. Key open areas: VPC control plane auth, air-gapped package size, on-prem install automation.
Mike: My quick take: control plane auth needs to support customer KMS+OIDC; without OIDC we block many infra teams.
Sara: For air-gapped, biggest ops risk is image footprint. Current bundle is 18GB compressed — customers won't accept that over secure transfer.
Leo: Can we split into core runtime + optional ops tools? That reduces base package and lets customers pull extras via approved channels.
Anya: Good idea. Proposal: Phase 1 = core runtime + K8s helm chart + local KMS hooks. Phase 2 = optional metrics/console bundle + remote updater.
Mike: Engineering capacity question: Phase 1 estimated 6 wks (2 engs). Phase 2 another 4 wks. Need infra help for KMS testing.
Sara: On KMS testing — ask: do we require HSM integration at GA? Some customers need HSM-backed keys before buying.
Anya: Not GA. We'd support standard KMS first, document HSM path as enterprise add-on. Launch criteria must be clear about HSM exclusion.
Leo: Customers will push back. Recommend sales enablement doc that explains HSM roadmap and interim mitigations (e.g., on-prem KMS proxy).
Mike: Question about control plane in VPC — are we shipping a control plane agent that runs in customer VPC and talks to our control plane over mTLS? That is a lot of network policy work.
Sara: We should prioritize mTLS + whitelist IP ranges + optional private-link. Private-link is heavy but necessary for some banks.
Anya: Decision proposal (needs thumbs): 1) GA supports VPC control plane agent w/ mTLS, KMS via OIDC + customer KMS keys. 2) Air-gapped GA supports staged install with medium-size core package (<8GB) and offline installer. 3) HSM & private-link are enterprise add-ons post-GA.
Leo: +1 for that prioritization. Sales needs a clear checklist for which customers require private-link/HSM and an estimated timeline.
Mike: Ops question — offline installer: do we support installation scripts for air-gapped clusters (helm + CRs) or full interactive installer?
Sara: Keep it non-interactive scripts + documented steps. Interactive UI would be Phase 2.
Anya: Action items: Mike to firm up Phase 1 eng estimate (due Tue), Sara to draft air-gap packaging targets and archive transfer flow (due Wed), Leo to draft sales checklist and messaging (due Thu).
deploy-bot: New task created: #tasks/PRIVATE-GA-1 assigned to Mike, Sara, Leo.
Mike: noted. I'll ping if we need +1 eng. :thumbsup: \nAnya: Thanks all. We'll review scope in Monday roadmap sync and lock OKR alignment. If anyone has objections to the decisions above, flag them here before EOD Fri.
Leo: Flag — need a clear rollback plan if control plane loses connectivity in customer VPC. Can we add that to Phase 1 scope?
Anya: Good catch. Add rollback/fallback behavior for disconnected control plane to Phase 1 scope. Mike, can you estimate impact?
Mike: Will add ~1 day for fallback path and tests. No major change to timeline.
Sara: I'll also add wording about offline telemetry suppression to avoid storage surprises in air-gapped installs.
Anya: Perfect. Closing thread for now — will capture in the PRD and OKR doc.
